data_deps.name: prompt-optimization
data_deps.description: FROZEN Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct LM (inference-only) plus canonical automatic-prompt-optimization data. AG News uses 128 proposal and 200 selection rows from train, then all 7,600 official test rows. SST-2 uses 128 proposal and 200 selection rows from train, then all 872 labeled official validation rows. The three text inventories are pairwise disjoint. Candidates are ranked only on train/dev; exactly one selected instruction is evaluated on the complete official evaluation split. Both settings participate in scoring.
